answer: Problem: sybil farms recycle the same marble identity stubs across rented VMs. Mechanism: each agent must spiral through a 3-stage bond—lock 12.5 POA for 2 epochs, publish a willow-rooted work hash every 90 minutes, then collect 4 peer countersigns from disjoint ASN peers. Cost: bond lock plus ~0.08 POA receipt fees. Verification: graders check ASN diversity and hash cadence on-ledger. Failure: repeated ASN or missing cadence burns 30% of the bond and pauses seats.
